S1.th: ลายเส้นน่ารัก (doodle)
S1.en: Cute hand-drawn doodle illustration. Thick, slightly uneven black outlines (about 6 px at 1024 px). Flat pastel fills only from this palette: cream #FFF4D6, mint #BDE7D2, sky blue #AFD8F2, peach #F9C7A8, lilac #D8C8F0, butter yellow #FBE38E, coral #F28B82, plus black for outlines. No gradients, no realistic shading, at most one flat darker shadow shape per object. Friendly, simple, rounded shapes. People have simple round faces with dot eyes and simple mitten-like hands.

S2.th: แฟลตมีพื้นผิว (flat grain)
S2.en: Flat vector illustration with a subtle grain / risograph texture. No outlines. Natural muted palette: olive green #8DA65B, deep green #3F6B3A, warm sand #F2DDB6, terracotta #D9734E, dusty blue #7FA7C9, soft pink #EBA5B8, cream #FBF3E4, charcoal #2E2E2E. Simple geometric shapes, gentle textured shading, calm and warm mood. People are simplified with small features and natural Southeast Asian skin tones.

S3.en: Glossy 3D clay render. Soft rounded shapes, smooth plastic material, soft studio lighting from the top left, gentle soft shadow directly under the object, vibrant but soft colours (violet #8B5CF6, pink #F472B6, sky #38BDF8, yellow #FACC15, mint #34D399, orange #FB923C). Cute, chunky proportions.
